# Redis Provider

Manages a single (non-cluster) Redis 7.0+ or Valkey 7.2+ server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# credentials can only be set with the REDIS_USERNAME and REDIS_PASSWORD environment variables
provider "redis" {
  # rediss:// for TLS
  url = "rediss://redis.example.com:6379"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) Server URL, `redis://host:port`, or `rediss://host:port` for TLS. [go-redis URL options](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#ParseURL) are supported, e.g. `?dial_timeout=5s`. Must not contain credentials.
